articles.title_en: Tu-95MS bomber crashed in Russia, killing eight officers. Some helped organize missile strikes on Ukraine.
articles.lead_en: Eight Russian officers were killed when a Tu-95MS missile-carrying bomber crashed in the Amur region on September 29. The independent Russian news outlet Mediazona published the full list of those on board.
